# Trimble Connect Org Service (Core Account / Organizer)

- **Definition:** [org-prod@v1](https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/Trimble-Connect/org-prod/v1), status ga. Security schemes: Bearer.
- **Developer Portal:** https://developer.trimble.com/docs/connect/reference/openapi/organizer/.
- **Regions:** ap, ap-au, eu, eu-gb, us.
- **Calling from the MCP:** pass the operation `key` (`org:METHOD path`) to `trimble_api_read` (read) or `trimble_api_plan` (plan), with `product: "trimble-connect"`. Path, query and header parameters are validated against this catalogue.
